LOOK (Efeonce photographic language v2): premium editorial business photography, like a feature story in a top business magazine. Shot on a full-frame camera. Natural, true-to-life color exactly as the scene looks, rich clean blacks, clean highlights, soft natural contrast; no color grading, no filter, no teal-and-orange, no HDR, no added grain. Motivated, directional light: soft window light from one side, gentle modeling on faces, never flat, never flash. Restraint and calm: few objects, noble real materials (oak wood, linen, paper, brushed metal), uncluttered. Real skin texture and real fabric, no retouching look. People genuinely working together, mid-conversation, not looking at the camera, no stock smiles, no handshakes, no thumbs up. Contemporary Santiago de Chile professional setting, specific and lived-in, not a generic glass office. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks anywhere.

POINT OF VIEW (essential): the photograph is taken from the CLIENT'S OWN SEAT at the table. The camera sits where the client sits, so the viewer is placed inside the working session.

SCENE (vertical 4:5): A working session in a meeting room with large windows, soft overcast daylight from the left. Across a dark walnut table, a Chilean strategist in her late thirties, wearing a plain deep navy polo with no logo, explains something with an open-hand gesture while her laptop (fully inside the frame, screen showing a clean abstract dashboard of soft blue and grey shapes with no legible text) sits beside her; next to her a colleague in his thirties listens and writes in a paper notebook. Both people are placed around the horizontal center of the frame, fully visible from the chest up. Camera: 85mm lens at f/1.8, from the client's own seat, lens only a few centimeters behind the near edge of the table, lens height just above the tabletop, focus on the strategist's eyes. FOREGROUND (planned, part of the point of view): the nearest part of the client's side of the dark walnut table is so close to the lens that it renders as a strongly out-of-focus, DARK band in soft shadow across the ENTIRE width of the bottom 14% of the frame, with a soft blurred edge; behind that band the tabletop gradually comes into focus toward the people. Nothing on that near edge. The upper quarter is softly out-of-focus wall and window light.
